text: The initiative was characterized by a multi-layered approach involving aggressive demand management, emergency supply augmentation through tanker deliveries and inter-municipal transfers, and preparations for an inter-basin emergency release from Doam Dam. A Water Quality Verification Committee was established to manage risks associated with alternative water sources. The initiative also prioritized vulnerable populations by distributing bottled water to schools and senior welfare facilities.

metadata.solution_name: State of National Disaster for Drought in Gangneung (2025)
